baseline: HcPre returns BF16 Y and live coefficients; separate input RMSNorm consumes Y using its original learned weight and epsilon.
algorithm: First produce Y with original BF16 rounding. RMSNorm mathematically returns weight * Y / sqrt(mean(Y^2) + eps); actual native reduction/rounding order remains a validation constraint.
proposal: Within an operator implementation, retain the rounded Y for full-H normalization and publish normalized output; preserve current coefficient/residual/reader interfaces. No F01 parallelism required.
